name: Keeper in dust mask
design: Compact stout adult male Yautja, mottled grey hide, thick black scalp tendrils and big alien rear cranium. Wears a FUNCTIONAL FULL-FACE dark bronze stable dust respirator covering eyes, entire mouth and all mandibles with a broad smooth mask and two small side filters; no human nasal tubes. Ochre rolled-sleeve work smock, charcoal divided apron and broad utility belt. Holds a closed feed sack at his waist in both clawed hands, slight relaxed forward bend. No weapons.
